model: Three Flink 2.2/JDK 11 runtime partitions; maximum observed class times across hosts, including failed/interrupted runs. Scheduling estimates only, not measured speedup or passing-test evidence.

local_fork_diagnostic.native_mode: debug, matching CI; not a streaming performance benchmark
local_fork_diagnostic.limits: One serial-order paired diagnostic, with fresh JVMs per class and 4 GiB per-fork heaps. Includes Maven and unchanged protobuf regeneration/recompilation in both runs. Not a repeated benchmark, full hosted-CI memory qualification, idle-host claim or forecast of complete CI latency.
